big: Nifty Infrastructure is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Infrastructure track?
Tracks up to 30 F&O-eligible companies from telecom, power, ports, airlines, roads, railways, shipping and other utility services in the Nifty 500. It holds 30 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
